news.title: When Qini Rewards the Wrong Uplift Model, Use Doubly Robust Scores
news.dek:
On 1 million simulated customers, calibrated Qini scored a Linear DR learner 0.0856 against 0.0826 for the true-CATE ranking that should have won. 
 The post  When Qini Rewards the Wrong Uplift Model, Use Doubly Robust Scores  appeared first on  Towards Data Science .
news.aiSummary: The article reports that on a dataset of one million simulated customers, a calibrated Qini metric gave a higher score to a Linear DR learner (0.0856) than to the true CATE ranking (0.0826), which should have been the winner. This suggests that Qini can reward the wrong uplift model, and the post recommends using doubly robust scores instead.
